programme.title: Grabouillon
programme.desc: Grabouillon écrase la grenade de Pétunia et tente de traverser l'île pour en cueillir une autre, mais son périple tourne vite au parcours du combattant ! . Chargé de garder Tatouwak, il lui donne du chocolat, provoquant une folle course-poursuite. Pour finir un puzzle, il risque tout en entrant dans la caravane. Devenu gardien de l'île, son « code » trop strict embête tout le monde !

programme.title: Lulu Vroumette
programme.desc: Qui-sait-tout est vexé : ses histoires sont mises en doute, surtout celle de la « plante qui danse ». Lulu et ses amis veulent l'aider à prouver la vérité. Pendant ce temps, Lulu fait découvrir aux copains un nouveau jouet, les Boubouzes, qui provoquent une vraie folie. Jusqu'où cela ira-t-il ?

programme.title: Lulu Vroumette
programme.desc: Blaise, délaissé par Frou-Frou, fait croire qu'il est blessé pour attirer l'attention. Mais son rôle de « grand blessé » l'isole vite. Comment réparer ça ? Pendant ce temps, la bande demande à Frou-Frou de les aider à faire une carte, mais la chouette, distraite, se cogne et craint de voler.

programme.title: Lulu Vroumette
programme.desc: La maîtresse montre à Lulu une sculpture faite d'objets assemblés et propose de créer une œuvre collective. Les idées fusent, entre sérieux et absurdité, jusqu'à ce que Lulu trouve l'inspiration. Pendant ce temps, les amis cherchent un cadeau pour Brico, qui préfère réparer son coucou suisse tranquillement.

programme.title: Lulu Vroumette
programme.desc: Lulu a découvert une baguette de sourcier et devient accro à la recherche de l'eau. Ses copains ne savent plus comment l'arrêter...Cette année, c'est RNS qui doit imaginer et fabriquer la plus importante décoration du sapin de Noël de la classe : l'étoile que l'on met au sommet...

programme.title: Lulu Vroumette
programme.desc: Les enfants tentent de faire naître une amitié entre Brico et Qui-Sait-Tout...Comment savoir qui est son meilleur ami ? En écoutant son coeur...

programme.title: Petites Poules
programme.desc: Carmélito libère un génie de lampe, mais gaspille deux vœux dans ses disputes. Le génie disparaît avant le dernier souhait, mais Carmen le retrouve avec un festin. Pendant ce temps, Cokpapy se dispute avec sa sœur Roussie, venue garder le poulailler. Enlevée par Coléra, elle est sauvée grâce à sa cornemuse. Réconciliés, frère et sœur retrouvent leur complicité d'enfance.

programme.title: Petites Poules
programme.desc: Carmélito, fou amoureux de Coquillette, devient l'inspirateur de Shakespeare et incarne Roméo. Pendant une répétition, Coquillette est capturée par les rats, mais Carmélito la sauve héroïquement. Plus tard, Coquenpâte et Bangcoq, fugueurs enfermés dehors, tombent dans un piège des rats. Heureusement, Carmen, Carmélito, Bélino et Tom Sawyer volent à leur secours !

programme.title: Sherlock Yack
programme.desc: Le Phacochère, amateur de boue, découvre son enclos tout propre. Qui a fait ça ? Hermine essaie de relooker Sherlock, mais son imperméable écossais reste son style. Chihuahua organise un casting pour une pièce sur un détective comme Sherlock. L'Orang-outan, un candidat, se fait éliminer quand un téléphone lui est collé à l'oreille !

programme.title: Sherlock Yack
programme.desc: Boa gagne le trophée musical, mais on lui vole après la cérémonie. Qui parmi les concurrents est coupable ? Pendant ce temps, Hermine cache à Sherlock qu'elle a planqué sa cornemuse. Sherlock est épuisé : quelqu'un l'appelle toutes les nuits pour le harceler. Hermine doit gérer ce détective fatigué et réveiller son génie.

programme.title: Marcus Level
programme.desc: Vipkrad hante le palais du Calife. Marcus et ses amis doivent chasser ses fantômes avant que le Calife, très peureux, ne se réveille. Peu impressionnés, Marcus et Ephi, mais pas Gratrok. Ensuite, Marcus doit sauver le Génie Baloumba des 40 voleurs et gagne un fragment de miroir. Mais il dépense tout l'argent en trésors inutiles, créant la zizanie.

programme.title: Marcus Level
programme.desc: Aux championnats des Sept Tours de Lumières, Marcus rêve de gagner la coupe remise par son idole, Copacabanana. Ephi et Gratrok ne comprennent pas son obsession. Ensuite, Marcus affronte Cusmar, un fantôme lié à un record triché. Effondré, il enseigne la triche à ses amis… et si c'était la clé pour gagner ?

programme.title: Grabouillon
programme.desc: Gonzague ramène un hypnodéon hypnotique. Bagou contrôle tout le monde, mais Grabouillon reprend l'objet. Une partie de pétanque tourne mal à cause de la taupe, accusant Grabouillon à tort. Avec un téléphone en ficelle, ils secourent Cunégonde. La super-balle de Grabouillon cause un cauchemar, qu'il décide de quitter en l'enterrant.

programme.title: Pingu
programme.sub-title: S2:E2 Pingu et le gros poisson | Pingu montre ce qu'il sait faire | Pingu déneige
programme.desc: S2:E2 Pingu et le gros poisson | Pingu montre ce qu'il sait faire | Pingu déneige - Pingu part à la pêche et promet d'être de retour pour le dîner. | Pingu et Pinga jouent, mais quand Pingi arrive, Pingu décide qu'il est trop vieux pour les jouets et préfère frimer devant elle. | Pingu élabore un plan pour protéger la voiture de son père de la neige.

programme.title: Pingu
programme.sub-title: S2:E3 Le jour de congé de Pingu | Pingu l'archer | Pingu reçoit un avertissement
programme.desc: S2:E3 Le jour de congé de Pingu | Pingu l'archer | Pingu reçoit un avertissement - Pingu a un jour de congé et veut profiter de sa liberté plutôt que d'aider maman. | Pingu fait quelques bêtises après avoir trouvé un arc et une flèche. | Pingu ignore un avertissement sur son cerf-volant près de la maison de son voisin grincheux et doit le récupérer.

programme.title: Pingu
programme.sub-title: S2:E4 Pingu et l'aimant | Pingu reçoit de l'aide | Pingu au paradis
programme.desc: S2:E4 Pingu et l'aimant | Pingu reçoit de l'aide | Pingu au paradis - Pingu découvre un aimant et décide de l'utiliser pour piéger son ami. | Pingu joue avec son bateau, mais il coule à cause d'une fuite. | Après s'être endormi en jouant avec ses jouets, Pingu fait un rêve très doux.

programme.title: Pingu
programme.sub-title: S2:E5 La blague dangereuse de Pingu | Pingu le pilote | Pingu taquine Pinga
programme.desc: S2:E5 La blague dangereuse de Pingu | Pingu le pilote | Pingu taquine Pinga - Pingu fait une blague dangereuse à son grand-père. | Pingu et Pinga construisent leur avion après en avoir vu un vrai. | Pingu taquine tellement sa sœur avec ses blagues qu'elle est presque en pleurs.

programme.title: Pingu
programme.sub-title: S2:E6 Le vœu de Pingu | Pingu est curieux | Pingu s'organise
programme.desc: S2:E6 Le vœu de Pingu | Pingu est curieux | Pingu s'organise - Pingu voit un kit de magie dans le magasin et le veut vraiment. | Pingu découvre un gros cadeau pour son anniversaire. Il veut l'ouvrir mais on lui dit d'attendre. | Quand papa insiste pour que Pingu range tout à sa place, Pingu s'organise.

programme.title: Pingu
programme.sub-title: S2:E7 Pingu construit une tour | Pingu le roi | Pingu le boulanger
programme.desc: S2:E7 Pingu construit une tour | Pingu le roi | Pingu le boulanger - Pingu voit dans un livre une tour qui monte jusqu'au ciel et veut en construire une identique. | Pinga découvre un livre sur les royaumes et Pingu pense que ce serait génial d'être roi. | Pingu veut faire son propre gâteau.

programme.title: Pingu
programme.sub-title: S2:E8 Pingu et la poupée | Pingu aide grand-père | La mauvaise journée de Pingu
programme.desc: S2:E8 Pingu et la poupée | Pingu aide grand-père | La mauvaise journée de Pingu - Le bras de l'ours de Pinga se détache quand Pingu joue avec. | Pingu part à pied aider grand-père à cause des retards de la motoneige. | Pingu trébuche sur ses jouets, fait un mauvais trajet jusqu'à l'école et ne sait pas répondre au maître.

programme.title: Pingu
programme.sub-title: S2:E9 Pingu perd le pari | Pingu et sa coupe | La carte de Saint-Valentin de Pingi
programme.desc: S2:E9 Pingu perd le pari | Pingu et sa coupe | La carte de Saint-Valentin de Pingi - Pour se montrer, Pingu parie avec Pinga qu'il est meilleur qu'elle pour viser une boîte avec des balles. | Pingu est très mauvais lors de sa journée sportive. En aidant un ami lors de la dernière épreuve, Pingu gagne le premier prix. | Pingu est ravi de recevoir une carte de Saint-Valentin de Pingi.

programme.title: Pingu
programme.sub-title: S2:E10 Pinga somnambule | Pingu fait des bonds | Le lapin perdu de Pinga
programme.desc: S2:E10 Pinga somnambule | Pingu fait des bonds | Le lapin perdu de Pinga - Pingu doit surveiller Pinga lorsqu'elle marche en dormant hors de l'igloo et traverse les maisons des autres. | Pingu rebondit sur tout dans l'igloo, de son lit aux fauteuils. | Pingu taquine sa sœur et son lapin en peluche préféré tombe par la fenêtre.

programme.title: Pingu
programme.sub-title: S2:E11 Le jour venteux de Pingu | Pingu veut voler | Pingu creuse un trou
programme.desc: S2:E11 Le jour venteux de Pingu | Pingu veut voler | Pingu creuse un trou - Pingu et Pinga étendent le linge. Quand une grosse rafale de vent emporte les serviettes, ils se lancent à leur poursuite. | Regarder une mouette voler donne envie à Pingu de voler. | Après que papa a déneigé son chariot, Pingu s'amuse un peu à creuser lui-même.

programme.title: Pingu
programme.sub-title: S2:E12 Pingu finit le travail | Robby le snowboarder | L'aventure lunaire de Pingu
programme.desc: S2:E12 Pingu finit le travail | Robby le snowboarder | L'aventure lunaire de Pingu - Papa essaie de fabriquer une table mais passe son temps à éloigner Pingu de sa boîte à outils. | Pingu fait du snowboard avec Robby et souhaite être aussi doué pour les sauts que son ami. | Grand-père parle de la lune à Pingu, qui veut désespérément s'y rendre.

programme.title: Pingu
programme.sub-title: S2:E13 Pingu et Pinga font du camping | Pinga a le hoquet | Tel père, tel Pingu

programme.title: Trop jeune pour ça
programme.desc: Carly, Sam et Freddie sont invités à assister à un combat d'arts martiaux pour filmer en coulisses. Mais Spencer et Mrs Benson refusent de les laisser y aller.

programme.title: Que le meilleur chante
programme.desc: Carly, Sam et Freddie demandent aux fans d'iCarly de voter pour David Archuleta afin qu'il remporte AMERICA SINGS. Mais ils se sentent mal à l'aise par rapport au deuxième et l'aident à créer son clip.

programme.title: Sam devient gentille
programme.desc: Sam craque sur un garçon qui n'aime que les filles très féminines. Carly aide alors Sam à se relooker.

programme.title: Carly et Clyde
programme.desc: Griffin, le nouveau voisin de Carly et Spencer, vole la moto que Carly a offert à Spencer.

programme.title: La meilleure amie
programme.desc: Missy Robinson, l'ancienne amie de Carly, revient dans sa vie. Sam se sent alors mise de côté.

programme.title: iCarly
programme.desc: Carly, Sam et Freddie perdent l'URL iCarly au profit de Nevel. Ce dernier demande à Carly de l'embrasser en échange de l'URL. De son côté, Spencer s'amuse avec les deux cent oreillers qu'il a commandés par erreur...

programme.title: Le combat
programme.desc: Carly et la championne d'arts martiaux Shelby Marx acceptent de se livrer à une démonstration de combat pour le compte d'une oeuvre de charité.

programme.title: Le combat
programme.desc: Carly et la championne d'arts martiaux Shelby Marx acceptent de se livrer à une démonstration de combat pour le compte d'une oeuvre de charité.

programme.title: iCarly
programme.desc: Carly, Sam et Freddie présentent les iCarly Awards. Ils récompensent en direct les auteurs des meilleurs contenus envoyés sur le site.

programme.title: Mélanie
programme.desc: Surprise, surprise ! Sam a une sœur jumelle appelée Mélanie. Et encore plus surprenant, elle est beaucoup plus féminine que Sam, et craque pour Freddie, qui la prend pour Sam déguisée.

programme.title: Carly et Clyde
programme.desc: Griffin, le nouveau voisin de Carly et Spencer, vole la moto que Carly a offert à Spencer.

programme.title: contre Dingo Channel
programme.desc: Carly, Sam et Freddie découvrent qu'une émission de télé sur Dingo Channel plagie des contenus d'iCarly. Ils décident alors de se rendre à Los Angeles pour confronter les auteurs de l'émission.

programme.title: Laveu
programme.desc: Sous l'influence d'un gaz hilarant chez le dentiste, Sam parle à Carly de son baiser avec Freddie.

programme.title: Le concours de cuisine
programme.desc: Carly et Sam utilisent la recette de taco aux spaghettis de Spencer à l'occasion d'un concours télévisé avec un grand Chef.

programme.title: Le principal Franklin
programme.desc: Après que le Principal Franklin se soit fait renvoyer accidentellement à cause de Carly, Sam et Freddie, Mme Briggs et Mr Howard prennent le contrôle de l'école et instaurent des règles sévères ainsi qu'un code vestimentaire.

programme.title: Aujourd'hui ma peau, demain la tienne
programme.desc: Le suave joueur Clay Watson, l'arrogant tireur d'élite Moses Lang et le rusé comédien Edwin Kean forment un trio de criminels dans le vieil Ouest.

programme.title: Le Retour de Sabata
programme.desc: Les citoyens de Hobsonville engagent Sabata pour les débarrasser du clan McIntock, qui les taxe de force et illégalement sous le prétexte du développement de la ville.

programme.title: Le banni
programme.desc: Les légendes de l'Ouest Pat Garrett, Doc Holliday et Billy the Kid s'affrontent pour la loi et les attentions de la vivace mégère Rio McDonald.

programme.title: Bandidos
programme.desc: Le célèbre tireur Richard Martin voyage à bord d'un train, retenu par Billy Kane, un ancien élève de Martin.

programme.title: Le salaire de la haine
programme.desc: Ken veut obtenir justice pour son frère Bill, qui a été tué par un tireur notoire nommé Stevens pour une carte de mine d'or.

programme.title: Mission Trésor
programme.desc: Julka, 12 ans, n'a encore jamais eu de véritable ami. Au lieu de suivre ses parents au Canada, Julka va devoir passer ses vacances chez sa tante à Varsovie. Elle rencontre alors Olek qui vit dans le même bâtiment.

programme.title: L'Esprit d'Halloween
programme.desc: Lorsqu'un magasin d'Halloween ouvre dans un centre commercial désert, trois amis, pensant avoir grandi, décident d'y passer la nuit enfermés. Mais leur soirée amusante tourne vite en lutte pour survivre face à des événements terrifiants.

programme.title: Sherlock Gnomes
programme.desc: Les adorables nains de jardin de «Gnoméo et Juliette» sont de retour pour une toute nouvelle aventure à Londres. Quand Gnoméo et Juliette arrivent en ville avec leurs amis et leur famille, leur préoccupation principale est de préparer leur jardin pour le printemps.

programme.title: Rex, chien pompier
programme.desc: Le chien le plus choyé d'Hollywood s'égare lors d'un tournage publicitaire et devient la mascotte d'une caserne de pompiers locale.

programme.title: Ursli, l'enfant des montagnes
programme.desc: Un garçon doit braver la neige profonde de l'hiver pour obtenir un précieux souvenir de famille. Avant même de pouvoir commencer ce difficile voyage, il doit d'abord aider sa famille à survivre à la ruine financière, sauver sa chèvre bien-aimée...

programme.title: Drone
programme.desc: Un pilote de drone expert qui travaille pour la CIA partage sa vie entre ses missions et sa vie de famille dans une petite ville de banlieue, jusqu'à ce qu'une fuite fasse de lui la cible d'un mystérieux homme d'affaires pakistanais.

programme.title: 7 Minutes
programme.desc: Après avoir contracté une dette auprès d'un dangereux baron de la drogue, trois jeunes hommes désespérés décident de commettre un braquage pour réunir l'argent qui leur manque.

programme.title: Le Passager
programme.desc: En pleine crise de la quarantaine, Charles Duprey décide d'aller flamber au casino de Reno pour le week-end afin de décompresser. Sur la route il évite de justesse une voiture en panne. Après réflexion, il accepte de conduire son propriétaire, Hunter, jusqu'à la ville la plus proche… Mais au fil des kilomètres, son inquiétude augmente face à cet inconnu…

programme.title: Madtown
programme.desc: Un homme, terrifié par sa soeur, doit se confronter à cette dernière des années plus tard, lorsqu'elle est libérée de prison.

programme.title: Ni vu ni connu
programme.desc: Embauché par une femme qui se pense trompée, pour kidnapper et corriger la maîtresse de son mari, un escroc à la petite semaine met au point avec une de ses connaissances une combine pour empocher facilement l'argent. Mais le jour de la confrontation, les choses prennent un tour inattendu.

programme.title: Il faut qu'on parle
programme.desc: Nous avons tous quitté un jour, un(e) conjoint(e) sans raisons valables, si ce n'est l'envie de passer à autre chose. Et bien c'est ce que va faire le personnage d'Adam. Mais l'annonce de sa décision ne va pas se passer comme prévue…

programme.title: Où elle est maman ?
programme.desc: Roberto, Pablo et Sacha sont trois frères. Il y a quelques jours ils viennent de perdre leur maman. Leur papa, Joseph, semble ne pas se préoccuper de la situation. Pour lui, son épouse est encore là. C'est dans cet étrange contexte que les trois hommes vont devoir accompagner leur père dans cet instant difficile, de la marche funèbre à cette nuit où il va disparaître.

programme.title: Underwater
programme.desc: Jeanne Clairsen, "Oreille d'Or" dans la marine, est appelée par le Commissaire Delattre, afin qu'elle perce tous les bruits qui apporteraient la preuve qu'une nouvelle victime est bien détenue chez le suspect qu'ils ont mis sur écoute.

programme.title: Yùl et le serpent
programme.desc: Yùl, treize ans, accompagne son grand frère Dino pour conclure un deal avec Mike, petite frappe accompagnée de son dogue argentin. Alors que la situation tourne mal, un étrange serpent apparaît.

programme.title: À demi mot
programme.desc: Quand Laurène et Sacha se réveillent dans les bras l'un de l'autre, leur amour semble être une évidence, jusqu'à ce que les mots viennent s'immiscer dans leur histoire.

programme.title: Marche arrière
programme.desc: Juin 2013. Un mouvement protestataire occupe le parc Gezi à Istanbul. La tension monte entre les manifestants et la police qui se montre de plus en plus violente. Pendant ce temps, la télévision turque diffuse des documentaires sur les pingouins. Marche arrière est un film autocensuré dénonçant cette censure.

programme.title: Jacques a soif
programme.desc: Jacques a soif mais son PMU ne veut plus de lui et ses poches sont vides.

programme.title: Mon plus beau mariage
programme.desc: Une jeune femme regarde la vitrine d'une boutique de robes de mariées. Elle s'imagine dans chacune des robes le jour de son mariage. Laquelle va-t-elle choisir ?

programme.title: Tranche de campagne
programme.desc: Le soleil brille sur la campagne. Une famille d'animaux se trouve un endroit plaisant pour pique-niquer. À proximité, une bête broute paisiblement. L'ambiance bucolique de ce déjeuner sur l'herbe va changer…

programme.title: Un conte de la Goutte d'or
programme.desc: Dans le quartier de la Goutte d'or, quatre jeunes solitaires que rien ne lie, vont se rencontrer à la suite de minuscules incidents. S'en suit une aventure au coeur de l'un des plus célèbres quartiers de Paris.

programme.title: Regarder Oana
programme.desc: Oana travaille. Et moi je la regarde. Ce soir, ce dernier dossier sera plié. Elle ne veut plus traduire les mots des autres. Elle pense que demain elle va commencer à écrire pour elle. Mais elle ne le fera pas. Je le sais....

programme.title: Bleu-Gris
programme.desc: Fin août. Corse. Elbe, dix-sept ans, sourde de naissance est en vacances chez sa grande sœur Mathilde. Un jour, alors qu'elle se rend au phare de la Revellata, elle aperçoit un homme qui remonte seul d'une plongée sous marine…

programme.title: Rase campagne
programme.desc: Un village perdu dans la campagne finistérienne. Un homme est suspecté d'être porteur du virus Ebola. Il est noir. C'est Maurice. Son meilleur ami, Michel, ambulancier, sillonne le territoire avec son stagiaire Rémi pour le retrouver et le contrôler…

programme.title: Les amoureuses
programme.desc: Sara a quinze ans elle passe ses journées d'été au bord de la piscine accompagnée de sa mère, de sa petite sœur et de ses copines. La fin du mois d'août sera traversée par la rencontre d'un jeune homme, Lilian, pour lequel Sara et sa mère éprouvent le même désir.

programme.title: La virée à Paname
programme.desc: Mourad, vingt ans, vivote entre cours de théâtre, sorties entre potes et petite copine. Ce jour-là, il décide de quitter son quartier pour se rendre à un atelier d'écriture, à Paris. Mais la démarche va s'avérer plus compliquée que prévu.

programme.title: Toutes les belles choses
programme.desc: Le jour se lève. Tout le monde dort, sauf la mariée, Jessica. Elle est bientôt rejointe par Cathy, qui ne dort pas non plus. Ce sont les plus vieilles amies de la terre et elles vont passer un peu de temps ensemble, ce matin.

programme.title: La répétition
programme.desc: Stéphane rêve de devenir comédien. Carole, elle, rêve d'une augmentation.

programme.title: Spotted
programme.desc: Un fugitif se fait intercepter par deux douaniers crapuleux alors qu'il tentait d'échapperà son destin. Au cours d'un interrogatoire musclé, Big Mike et son sous-fifre s'efforcent de démenteler son réseau clandestin et de mettre fin à ses rêves de liberté.

programme.title: Retrosexe
programme.desc: 2065.Persuadés que le sexe c'était mieux avant, une bande d'adolescents part sur les traces du Retrosexe.

programme.title: Dans le nez
programme.desc: “Dans le nez” est une histoire d'amour, de dégoût et de chimie volatile. Un conte où les montagnes sont des flacons, les aisselles des sources et les fantômes des parfums.

programme.title: Braise
programme.desc: Lors d'une soirée bien arrosée, un jeune homme trompe sa copine avec une jolie et exubérante Anglaise. Trois de leurs amis observent et commentent cette aventure. Un parallèle se crée entre cette conversation et l'étreinte des deux amants.

programme.title: L'amour libre
programme.desc: Dans un café parisien, deux bonnes amies, l'une célibataire et l'autre en union libre, se réunissent pour faire le point sur leur vie et leurs amours.

programme.title: Papa oom mow mow
programme.desc: Rouen, 1986. Par ennui, par amour, par opportunité (ou par miracle), Frank subit un choc capillaire, qui change sa triste vie dans sa pluvieuse ville...

programme.title: Le Meurtrier
programme.desc: Dans ce thriller d'action haletant, un chauffeur de taxi de Yanji, dans la préfecture autonome coréenne de Yanbian, au nord-est de la Chine, se rend en Corée du Sud à la demande d'un gangster local qui lui propose d'éliminer un professeur en échange du remboursement de sa dette. Parallèlement, il recherche sa femme, venue le rejoindre mais sans nouvelles depuis six mois. Ses soupçons d'infidélité le rongent, jusqu'à ce qu'un événement inattendu survienne cette nuit-là. Alors qu'il s'apprête à tuer le professeur, il se retrouve bientôt en fuite, traqué par la police et la mafia, donnant lieu à de violents combats et à d'intenses courses-poursuites.

programme.title: Cyborg X
programme.desc: Après que X-Corp, un fabricant d'armes radical, ait été envahi par un cybervirus, un groupe de survivants doit se battre pour sauver l'humanité de l'armée de machines que le virus contrôle désormais.

programme.title: Les Nazis Au Centre De La Terre
programme.desc: Des Nazis ont réussi à se cacher au centre de la Terre et y préparent le retour en force du IIIe Reich. Des chercheurs scientifiques, en Antarctique, sont ainsi kidnappés par des soldats masqués. Leur but? Préparer une armée constituée de corps revenus à la vie...

programme.title: Killerman
programme.desc: Moe Diamond est un blanchisseur d'argent à New York qui se réveille sans aucun souvenir, avec des millions de dollars en espèces volées et de la drogue. Il doit rapidement parcourir les rues à la recherche de réponses tout en essayant d'échapper à une équipe de policiers violents et corrompus.

programme.title: Cross Of Fire
programme.desc: L'histoire de l'ascension et de la chute du leader du Ku Klux Klan des années 1920, D.C. Stephenson.

programme.title: Last gasp
programme.desc: Un impitoyable promoteur immobilier tue le chef d'une tribu amérindienne afin de mener à bien ses projets. Cet acte déclenche alors une malédiction, l'esprit de sa victime le forçant à commettre des meurtres.

programme.title: The Little Unicorn
programme.desc: Un conte de fées moderne vraiment enchanteur, avec des effets spéciaux époustouflants. La vie heureuse de la jeune Polly et de son grand-père est bouleversée par la mort de son cheval préféré et la naissance magique d'un bébé licorne dans leur ferme. Lorsque le village découvre son secret, certains de ses personnages les plus rusés tentent de voler la créature mystique.

programme.title: Ratchet Et Clank
programme.desc: Ratchet et Clank unissent leur force, intelligence et courage pour lutter contre le maléfique Drek qui veut détruire la galaxie. Avec l'aide des Rangers Galactiques ils vont se lancer dans une aventure spectaculaire ! Ce duo de choc est basé sur la franchise des jeux vidéo Ratchet & Clank de Sony, qui a été écoulée à plus de 13 millions d'exemplaires à travers le monde.

programme.title: 6 Below : Miracle On The Mountain
programme.desc: D'après une histoire vraie, l'aventure de l'athlète Eric LeMarque, qui se perd en snowboard lors d'une puissante tempête. Il a survécu huit jours sans aucune aide, et alors qu'il était en plein sevrage d'une addiction à la drogue.

programme.title: Troupe d'élite
programme.desc: Inspiré des vrais faits de la Batalhão de Operações Policiais Especiais (BOPE), le Bataillon des opérations spéciales de la police militaire de Rio de Janeiro.

programme.title: Représailles : La traque sauvage
programme.desc: Une femme, ancienne militaire, pourchasse les hommes qui ont enlevé son fils. Elle prend tous les risques pour parvenir à le tirer des griffes des ravisseurs.

programme.title: Gunner
programme.desc: Lee Gunner, vétéran de guerre, part camper avec ses deux fils et leur oncle pour renouer avec eux. Mais leur séjour tourne mal lorsqu'ils attirent accidentellement l'attention d'un gang de motards impliqué dans un trafic de drogue.

programme.title: Chevalier
programme.desc: Un jeune écuyer se lance dans une aventure qui va changer sa vie, lui faire gagner le cœur d'une belle jeune fille et secouer le monde médiéval.

programme.title: Un Amour d'animateur
programme.desc: Savannah, coach de vie, aide Patrick, un animateur radio impopulaire, à relancer sa carrière et son image.

programme.title: Dix étudiants, un meurtrier
programme.desc: Un groupe d'adolescents se rend sur une île déserte à pour une fête et se retrouvent rapidement pris au piège.

programme.title: Petits meurtres sur le campus
programme.desc: Amy Winslow, professeur de littérature spécialisée dans le roman policier, enquête sur la mort d'un étudiant.

programme.title: The Substitute 2
programme.desc: Un mercenaire s'infiltre dans un lycée pour arrêter le gang d'adolescents qui a brutalement attaqué sa petite amie et assassiné son frère.

programme.title: Substitute 3: Winner Takes All
programme.desc: Une jeune enseignante est sauvagement agressée. Le mercenaire Karl décide de prendre les choses en main et de faire le ménage...

programme.title: Maison d'amis
programme.desc: Dans cette comédie outrancière et paillarde mettant en scène Pauly Shore (ENCINO MAN) et Steve-O ("Jackass"), un couple de jeunes fiancés achète la maison de ses rêves, mais le locataire fêtard (Shore) de la maison d'hôtes refuse de partir !

programme.title: Hercule à New York
programme.desc: Banni du mont Olympe, Hercule (Arnold Schwarzenegger) est envoyé sur Terre où il trouve le véritable amour et entame une carrière prometteuse dans le secteur des culturistes.

programme.title: Galacticop
programme.desc: Pour blanchir son nom un détective victime d'un coup monté fait équipe avec un gnome.

programme.title: Anchorman: The Legend of Ron Burgundy
programme.desc: Dans le monde de la télé des années 1970, Ron Burgundy et son équipe de Channel 4 présentent le journal le plus populaire de San Diego. Tout va bien dans leur monde d'hommes, jusqu'à ce que Veronica Corningstone, vedette montante, le chamboule.

programme.title: Pas un mot
programme.desc: Quand la fille du docteur Nathan Conrad est enlevée, un secret qu'une de ses patientes catatonique détient pourrait être son seul espoir.

programme.title: The Watcher FR
programme.desc: Après avoir souffert d'un tragique décès, un couple achète un motel dans le désert, mais découvre qu'une série d'événements dérangeants et inexpliqués ont pris place dans l'une des chambres les plus demandées.

programme.title: Ophélie
programme.desc: Ophelia s'attire les faveurs du jeune prince Hamlet. Une romance passionnée se noue entre les deux.

programme.title: Allociné
programme.desc: Retrouvez tous les dossiers spéciaux sur le cinéma et les séries.

programme.title: Dr Louise Newson On The Perimenopause Symptoms You're Ignoring
programme.desc: One in six women arriving at Dr Louise Newson's menopause clinic have suicidal thoughts. 92% see those thoughts reduce with natural hormones, so why are women still being prescribed antidepressants instead? Louise explains why women are being misdiagnosed with depression or anxiety when the root cause is hormonal. She walks through what the many different symptoms could look like, and how to talk to a GP about how you're feeling mentally and physically.

programme.title: Joe Locke On LGBTQ Self-Expression
programme.desc: Joe Locke was doing his A levels on the Isle of Man when Heartstopper came out on Netflix. Two days later he had 3 million new Instagram followers. Fearne and Joe share their experiences of being thrust into the spotlight as teenagers and how it's affected them mentally. He explores his fear that his success might just be a fluke and why he's so keen to prove he belongs in the industry. They discuss how vital LGBTQ+ representation like Heartstopper is on TV, and why Joe came out twice.

programme.title: Millie Gooch On Alcohol, Consent, & Hangxiety
programme.desc: Alcohol-fuelled hangxiety became so overwhelming for Millie Gooch that she decided to stop drinking altogether and founded the Sober Girl Society. Now, with an MSc in Mental Health and Addiction, she's spent years exploring our complicated relationship with alcohol and what sits underneath it.

programme.title: Joseph Fiennes on Learning to Live With Uncertainty
programme.desc: Actor Joseph Fiennes discusses why he needs creative challenges to thrive, and how doubt can become a productive force rather than a barrier. He reflects on playing England football manager Gareth Southgate on stage and television, exploring parallels between their approaches to negotiating fear and encouraging vulnerability in men.

programme.title: Paul Whitehouse & Dr Mine Conkbayir MBE
programme.desc: Comedian Paul Whitehouse and his wife Dr Mine Conkbayir MBE, who has a PhD in neuroscience, discuss emotional regulation and neurodiversity. Mine shares her late ADHD diagnosis at 43 and childhood trauma, while Paul explores how physical health scares have changed his lifestyle. They discuss how the education system needs to change for neurodiverse children, the usefulness of labels, how to calm others with your own behaviour, and why this married couple choose not to live together.

programme.title: Joe Lycett On Fatherhood, Burnout, & Finding Yourself Again
programme.desc: Comedian Joe Lycett discusses identity, fatherhood and burnout with Fearne Cotton. Joe reflects on how much of his stage persona has become who he actually is, why paternity leave triggered existential crises, and how he's come out the other side caring less about what anyone thinks. They also explore losing inhibitions in the age of camera phones, why playing around and making mistakes matters as an adult, and how Ant and Dec have accidentally changed Joe's behaviour at hotels.

programme.title: Nicole LePera On How To Re-parent Yourself
programme.desc: Psychologist Dr Nicole LePera discusses how childhood praise and well-intentioned parenting can leave us with patterns that run our adult lives on autopilot. She explains how to reparent your inner child, starting with finding a childhood photograph, and shares ways to tune in with your body throughout the day to release stress.

From meeps to releasing sausages to going footy mad, relive all of the best and worst moments from the last two years. Hear clashes with Rishi Sunak and Kemi Badenoch, awkward encounters with Donald Trump, and gaffes at various major summits.

programme.title: I Was Diagnosed With HIV At 17
programme.desc: Adrian Duggan was diagnosed with HIV at the age of 17 after going to the doctor for an STI test. Now 23, Adrian is a part of the 'You, Me and HIV' campaign. Launched in January of 2025, the campaign aims to tackle misconceptions surrounding a HIV diagnosis in order to help reduce the stigma experienced by people living with HIV across Ireland.

programme.title: FootballJOE Quiz

programme.title: JOE Pub Quiz with TommyInnit and Max Fosh
programme.desc: TommyInnit and Max Fosh go head-to-head in the Joe Pub Quiz with a YouTube twist, battling it out across rounds testing their knowledge of the platform, iconic YouTube moments and some of the biggest names in internet history. From guessing who said which iconic line, to throwback YouTube apologies from Logan Paul, classic Sidemen diss tracks and a final rapid-fire round where they have to identify famous YouTubers from photos. Along the way, Tommy and Max also get into some of the biggest debates in YouTube history, including whether we need to bring proper YouTube apologies back, the golden era of diss tracks and what KSI leaving the Sidemen means for them.

programme.title: When Did Elon Musk Lose His Mind?
programme.desc: When did Elon Musk make the jump from salesman to supervillain? Quinn Slobodian and Ben Tarnoff trace Musk's journey from tech billionaire to stalwart of the online right. From his upbringing in apartheid South Africa to the rise of Tesla and SpaceX, they detail his changing views on AI and the "woke mind virus", as well as his eventual alliance with Donald Trump. Slobodian and Tarnoff examine his industrial philosophy, what led him to the White House, his purchase of Twitter, and his various attempts to further fuse technology into our lives.

programme.title: Joe Pub Quiz with Eddie Hall & Expressions
programme.desc: Eddie Hall and Expressions take on a quiz about the Sidemen, Gen Z slang, old-school phrases, and iconic Sidemen quotes. From completely missing the mark to unexpectedly clutch answers, the episode is full of laughs as they attempt to decode Gen Z slang, test how well they know each other, and recall legendary Sidemen moments.

programme.title: Labour's Local Election Wipeout Analysed
programme.desc: Laura and Seán analyse the 2026 local elections, examining the winners and losers as Labour's poor form continues. Reform achieved significant gains with a landslide in councils across the country, whilst the Greens made notable wins in Hackney and Edinburgh. In Wales, Labour's First Minister failed to gain reelection as the party's troubles deepen. The question remains whether Keir Starmer can survive.

programme.title: On The Ground At Tommy Robinson's Unite The Kingdom rally
programme.desc: Around 60,000 people gathered at Parliament Square on 16 May for Tommy Robinson's Unite The Kingdom rally, ostensibly to defend freedom, protect children, and take the country back. It was the smaller of two protests in central London, with at least a quarter of a million attending a pro-Palestine rally commemorating the 78th anniversary of the Nakba and uniting against the far-right. On the rally's main stage, a man covered in bacon played the cello.

programme.title: AI CEOs Being Absolutely Insane
programme.desc: Have you ever paid attention to the voices behind the 'inevitable' AI revolution? OpenAI's Sam Altman, SpaceX's Elon Musk, and Palantir's Alex Karp are among the tech elite. They're building the models they claim will change work, politics, and life forever. But when they talk about this future, their rhetoric ranges from bizarre to sinister. From Musk's prediction that there's "a 10 to 20% chance of killer robots wiping out humanity" to Altman's sale of intelligence as utility, things look pretty bleak.

programme.title: Glen Powell Takes The Irish Test
programme.desc: Glen Powell and Edgar Wright are put to the test to see if they can earn themselves an honourary Irish passport. To do so, they must pass a series of tests to prove their Irishness. programme.title: Mr. Hit It And Quit It and The Baywatch Babe
programme.desc: If you think Patti Stanger has faced her toughest clients, you ain't seen nothing yet. When Candace brings in her good friend Marcellas Reynolds, a gay celebrity stylist with a bigger than life personality, Patti certainly has her hands full. Marcellas likes to “hit it and quit it” and never gets beyond surface looks with his partners. But when he miserably fails his love lesson, Patti makes him face his behavior resulting in an explosive moment you'd never expect. Realizing there's more going on than meets the eye, Patti tells Marcellas that he needs to go deeper and be vulnerable with others if he wants a chance at true love. At the same time, Donna D'Errico, a Baywatch babe formerly married to Nikki Sixx from Motley Crue, is back on the dating scene for the first time since her difficult divorce. Soon to be an empty nester, Donna needs Patti's guidance to have fun again and stop assuming men will disappoint her. Both Patti's clients have built walls to protect themselves and she and her team have to go into ninja matchmaker mode to break them down. And if Marcellas and Donna don't follow Patti's rules and open themselves to the possibilities out there, they'll go home alone.

programme.title: Crazy Kelly & The Desperate Housewife
programme.desc: 3rd Generation matchmaker Patti Stanger is back and better than ever. She's taken over an exclusive boutique hotel where she takes on the toughest cases she's ever seen. This week, Patti has two Real Housewives check in: Liar Magnet Claudia Jordan from Atlanta and “Crazy” Kelly Bensimon from New York. Patti helps Kelly get over her nasty reality TV reputation and see that her insecurity is all in her head. Claudia goes deep with Patti, and exposes her traumatic experiences with men that lead her to attract all the wrong men. Patti goes to extreme measures to get Claudia to thoroughly vet guys to find her Mr. Right. It's time to call the man who Claudia needs to confront in order to move on and find true love. Patti and her team gather the best of the best for a sexy all-male mingle where the housewives get their pick of the litter. The Housewives choose their dates, but will Claudia vet her date enough (or too much) and will Kelly keep the “crazy” away? At the end of the week, will these Housewives take their lessons to heart and go home crazy in love or will they check out alone?

programme.title: Mr. Self-Absorbed & The Trainwreck
programme.desc: Patti Stanger has never met clients who challenge her as much as the two this week. TV star Courtney Stodden is only 22 years-old but she's been in the media eye since she was 16, when she controversially married a 50-year-old actor. Now single, Courtney is making up for lost time by partying like a rockstar! Is Courtney straight, bi-sexual or gay, she's not sure so Patti preps for her first ever bi-sexual mingle. What we do know is that Courtney hates rules, she hates being told what to do and she hates keeping her clothes on. Patti is tasked with trying to tame this wild child who is mentally a rebellious 16-year-old, but to do so Patti is forced to use extreme measures. Meanwhile, MMA fighter Shondo Blades checks in with a huge chip on his shoulder and a strong need to be the center of attention. His excuse for having three kids with two women and never married is that women can't keep up with him. But during the love lesson, Patti checks him by pointing out he's a self-absorbed one man show that leaves no room for a co-star. And to add insult to injury, a commitment phoebe. Pissed at the truth, Shondo threatens to leave the Millionaire's Club and tensions explode. Can Patti find a way to break through to her combative clients or will their extreme behaviors sabotage their search for love?

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized) S1E13
programme.desc: Jeannie agrees not to date Roger if Tony doesn't go out with other girls. Then Tony and Roger are assigned to escort Russian cosmonauts Major Tiomkin and Major Posnovsky during a goodwill visit. Major Tiomkin proves to be a beautiful girl named Sonya, who immediately stakes a claim on Tony. Angered, Jeannie tells Tony she is going out with Roger. Tony imprisons Jeannie in her bottle. Jeannie maneuvers the bottle into the pocket of Roger's raincoat. Roger presents the bottle to Sonya. Tony gets involved in a fracas with General Barkley and Dr. Bellows in his unsuccessful try to get the bottle back. When Sonya opens the bottle, Jeannie appears. Pointing to Sonya as her new mistress, she tells the cosmonaut she can make her every wish come true.When the plane on which Sonya is scheduled to return leaves, Tony feels her country now has possession of a decisive secret weapon. Later, dripping furs and jewelry, Sonya comes to Tony's home. She tells him Jeannie has granted her fondest desire by turning her into a wealthy American. Sonya agrees to return the bottle if Tony marries her. Tony asks a last word with Jeannie. He tells Jeannie he can't marry Sonya. Jeannie solves the problem by creating a duplicate Tony for Sonya.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized) S1E14
programme.desc: Unable to persuade Tony to marry her, Jeannie decides she needs a mother's counsel. She blinks her eyes and Mama appears. Mama assures Jeannie Tony will change his mind if he thinks Jeannie is going to marry Roger. Tony asks Roger if he has met Jeannie's parents. Then Dr. Bellows announces he has bought the lot across the street. Roger asks to meet Jeannie's parents. She produces a house on Dr. Bellows' lot. Tony sees Dr. Bellows and General Hadley approaching the lot. Responding to Tony's pleas, Jeannie makes the house vanish. General Hadley and Dr. Bellows see Tony sitting in the weeds sipping tea. Making the house reappear, Jeannie produces parents for Roger's visit.Tony comes to the house and forbids Jeannie to marry Roger. Then Dr. Bellows drives up. Seeing the house, he becomes distraught, and runs to Tony. As the house disappears again, they see Roger sitting in the weeds. The following day, Roger tells Tony he found himself wandering around a vacant lot. When he returned to apologize, Jeannie and the house were gone. Smiling at Jeannie, hiding in his desk drawer, Tony assures Roger he Will let him know if he ever meets Jeannie again.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized) S1E15
programme.desc: Learning that Dr. Bellows has told General Peterson that Tony should marry for his emotional stability as an astronaut, Jeannie prepares for the wedding. She produces Phoney, a twin of Tony's, who starts romancing her as an example for Tony. Getting nowhere, Jeannie makes Phoney disappear. Later, Dr. Bellows sees a romantic interlude between Jeannie and Phoney and leaves Tony's house, certain a wedding has been set for the following Sunday afternoon. Although Tony tries to get out of his predicament, he realizes he is stuck when the General congratulates him on his coming wedding. Later, Tony tells Jeannie he is going through with the affair.Jeannie produces Phoney to show Tony how to act at the wedding. Phoney tries to get Jeannie to marry him before she makes him vanish. At the chapel, Jeannie runs away at the last moment. At home, Tony tries unsuccessfully to make Jeannie believe it was actually Phoney who appeared at the wedding. Sure it was Tony, Jeannie tells she ran away after deciding never to force herself on him. When Tony musingly asks what would happen had they gotten married, Jeannie insinuates he will never know.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized) S1E16
programme.sub-title: Get Me To Mecca On Time
programme.desc: Jeannie finds her strength and power to perform magic weakening. Tony makes her promise to rest during the day. At the base, Roger, pointing to an astrological chart in a magazine, tells Tony his horoscope shows a gorgeous brunette will enter Roger's life. Tony questions his belief in such nonsense. Later, Jeannie phones Tony and tells him she seems to be vanishing by degrees. Then she pops into his office. Reading Roger's magazine, she tells Tony it is the Day of the Ram, on which every Genie and her master must pilgrimage to Mecca, and standing in a precise spot, repeat the Sacred Words. Tony refuses to take her seriously, but begins to wonder when Roger introduces him to Diane, a beautiful brunette. Tony and Jeannie take off for Mecca.Since the city has changed, they run into difficulty locating the place where they must pronounce the Sacred Words. They find the place they are looking for is now a bank and break in. As they are about to be taken by the police, Jeannie begins to fade. Tony finds the correct spot and pronounces the incantation. Jeannie recovers and they leave for home. Thanking Tony for saving her life, Jeannie announces she is taking them to Paris for dinner. Deciding they have traveled enough for one day, Tony takes her to Cocoa Beach instead.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized) S2E44
programme.desc: Larry Tate invites Samantha and Darrin to a buffet for prospective client Charles Barlow. When they complain about the condition of their clothes, Aunt Clara uses magic to produce a dress for Samantha and a new suit for Darrin, who invites her along to the affair. Once there, Aunt Clara removes a fire hydrant so Darrin can park. At the party, Samantha's dress begins to vanish and Aunt Clara's other magical efforts begin to disintegrate. Agreeing to drop Barlow at his hotel, Darrin finds the hydrant has returned to its place beside the car. As a policeman approaches, Darrin's outer garments disappear. Aunt Clara's efforts to help result in chaos, with Barlow, Darrin and the policeman dressed in each other's clothing. Barlow leaves, vowing Darrin will never get his account, and still in his underwear, Darrin is jailed with Montague, an alcoholic. After Aunt Clara's attempts to clothe Darrin fail, Samantha goes to his cell with a suit of clothes. When Judge Crosetti hears Montague's mad account of a change of clothing in the cell, he releases Darrin. Larry Tate, having heard Barlow's equally wild story, decides his company is not interested in handling his account.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized) S2E45
programme.desc: Dr. Passmore, psychiatrist at a rest home, tells Samantha his patients would like to do something to mark the Centennial of the End of the War Between the States. Samantha tells him Darrin will publicize the affair. Annoyed, Darrin tells Passmore Samantha will write a script for the pageant. Darrin criticizes Samantha's wooden characters. Taking Endora's advice, Samantha uses magic to bring her characters to life, so she can describe them. Soon Confederate Captain Corcoran, Violet, a beautiful Yankee, and an Indian, added for a neutral touch, are wandering around the Stephens' home. Seeing them, Gladys Kravitz flips. When Darrin arrives, the characters refuse to leave. How-ever, they vanish when Darrin kisses Samantha. Gladys tells her story to Passmore. He prescribes for her, but seeing the characters himself, decides he needs a vacation. When Samantha's writing comes to a halt, Corcoran, Violet and the Indian finish the script themselves and leave. After the pageant, Samantha is asked to create a vaudeville revue for the rest home. Two song and dance men appear. Gladys sees them and runs screaming into the night. Samantha tells Darrin she'll need lots of love to keep the hoofers away.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized) S2E46
programme.desc: Darrin is struggling to create an advertising campaign for a toy ship model manufactured by Mr. Herding. When Samantha wonders whether the Stephens ' baby will look like his father, Endora turns Darrin into an eight-year-old. Returned to normal, Darrin goes to his office. Samantha repeats a disparaging remark Darrin made about Endora. Piqued, Endora turns Darrin into a boy at his office. Mr. Harding sees Darrin and compli-ments Larry on hiring a child to devise a campaign for a toy. Samantha uses magic to return Darrin to normal size but is called on time after time to change him from man to boy when Harding insists on having a point meeting with Darrin and the boy. Finally, as a child, Darrin meets two boys who tell him the ship model is no good because it can't do anything. As Darrin, the man, persuades Harding and Larry to make the changes suggested by the two boys, Samantha gratefully produces a kite for each. When Darrin tells her he'd like to join them, Saman-tha replies he'll have his own son to play with soon.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized) S2E47
programme.desc: Aunt Clara tells Samantha and Endora she is hiding from warlock Hedley Partridge, because she fears her old beau will discover her magic no longer works. Seeing in Hedley a husband for Aunt Clara, who has become a problem, Endora invites him to the Stephens home. Samantha decides to make sure Aunt Clara's tricks work. Unaware of this, Aunt Clara is sure her gift is returned when she matches all of Hedley's tricks. When Samantha goes out of the room, Aunt Clara tries to follow Hedley's ro-mantic suggestion that they turn themselves into nightingales, but Hedley becomes an animal, while Aunt Clara's lower half disappears. Gladys Kravitz, who has become hysterical watching the strange happenings, drags Abner over to the Stephens house. When Samantha returns Aunt Clara and Hedley to normal, Aunt Clara is crushed to learn that Samantha helped her all along. Gladys skeptically accepts Abner's explanation that Hedley's magic was performed with the aid of wires. Aunt Clara and Hedley each admit that none of their tricks work as well as they used to. Promising to return, Hedley leaves. Aunt Clara tells Samantha his parting gift a rhinestone doorknob, is more precious than an engagement ring.

programme.title: Jodha Akbar
programme.desc: Jodha Akbar is a period drama set in the sixteenth century, focusing on the political marriage between Mughal Emperor Akbar and Rajput Princess Jodha Bai. Initially a marriage of convenience, it evolves into a deep love story that changes the fate of India. The series portrays the era's wars, the complex relationships between the Mughals and Rajputs, and the political dynamics of the royal court. Akbar, raised as a ruthless conqueror, learns the meaning of love and compassion through Jodha, who despises the Mughals for their invasions. Their relationship transforms Akbar from a heartless ruler into the beloved Emperor Akbar, known for his justice and wisdom.

programme.title: Nature's Most Dangerous

Do they live up to their reputations, and who really is the most dangerous? From killer crocs to ferocious big cats, we'll run you through the most dangerous teeth, fangs, stingers and bites in the animal kingdom. These are the deadliest animals on planet earth.

In the 20th century alone, 35 million people died on roads worldwide - plus 1.5 billion injured! With the two-part "Death Roads - On the Road at the Limit," phoenix offers a documentary road movie along the world's most dangerous car routes.

programme.title: mareTV
programme.desc: Fjord, ford, bay, gulf: there are many names for the beautiful extensions of the Baltic Sea into the country. Eckernförde Bay is shaped by currents, surf and people. It stretches 17 kilometers to the town that gives it its name. Stephan Möller is the acting shooting master of the Eckernförder Bürgerschützengilde. He spent a whole year preparing the beach shooting festival and then this: fog, rain and a stiff breeze. Traditionally, the Eckernförde marksmen always shoot at a wooden bird in the direction of the sea at Whitsun. Under strict conditions! And these stipulate a clear view of at least one kilometer out into the bay. The event literally threatens to fall through, for the first time in 449 years. Around 3,000 soldiers are stationed at the Eckernförde naval base, but only a small group is allowed to call itself an elite unit: the mine divers. They are considered the toughest soldiers in the Navy. Anyone who wants to be one of them has to undergo extreme training. This year, just two candidates made it to the final round. Now they still have to pass the dreaded final exam: running 20 kilometers with marching gear and then swimming ten kilometers through Eckernförde Bay.

programme.title: Europe's far North
programme.desc: Lofoten is the rugged archipelago in the Norwegian Arctic Ocean. Whoever arrives here is really at the end. Moskenes is the end of the line, and anyone who wants to go further needs a boat or a plane. The only way to get to the open sea is via the Maelstrom, which is quite dangerous. On the outermost headland, there are only a few ruins left. The last inhabitants are long gone, a supply was hardly possible. But fishermen are on the way, mainly to catch cod. And there is the coastal administration, which takes care of broken sea marks and lighthouses. A visit to one of the luxurious ships of the Hurtig Line is not to be missed. They shuttle off rough coasts on an eleven-day trip between the Russian border and southern Norway. A floating workplace for a wide variety of professions. The island of Andøya is not served by the Hurtiglinie. It lies too far out in the Atlantic. One of the most important observatories in Europe is located here. A young woman, Sandra Blindheim, is the boss. She is responsible for the large laser that delivers important information to scientists around the world. On clear winter nights, there is a wonderful panoramic view of the aurora borealis.

programme.title: Elephants: Back to the Wild

programme.title: Elephants: Back to the Wild

programme.title: The Heart of Hawaii
programme.desc: The Oahu island is the economic and cultural centre of the Hawaiian archipelago, as well as being a paradise for surfers, active holidaymakers and freedom lovers. The island is home to more than half of all natives and almost eight million foreign guests annually. Anyone searching for peace and seclusion won't find either in Honolulu or Waikiki. Traffic congestion and a backdrop of skyscrapers belong to the town panorama. Hip cafes, galleries and young fashion firms have settled here, adding a new and modern flair to the capital. Cindy's Lei Shoppe, the Chinatown florists, has been here for more than 30 years. This is also because the so-called Leis, the tradition of floral decoration, usually offered as a flower necklace or as a headdress, is still an important part of Hawaiian culture. Keone Nunes is well-known for his traditional tattooing skills, whereby the so-called Kakau Tattoos are virtually hammered into the skin with a hippo tooth. But Oahu is also an island of overwhelming natural beauty and a fascinating diversity on the smallest of places ...

programme.title: mareTV
programme.desc: Wide open spaces, water, meadows: The Limfjord stretches through Jutland in Denmark in countless bays, canals and sounds. Mighty water castles, country palaces and magnificent monasteries are enthroned on its shores. It is a rather lonely area, even in high summer it is quiet. This is probably why the people here are so friendly and sociable. Birte, Silla and Bo cycle to their fjord garden project in the harbor of the town of Løgstør to harvest mussels, oysters and seaweed. They think gardening is best in a club. Luckily, Silla, a resourceful tinkerer, has just made another ingenious invention: the mussel washing machine. Cruising the narrow Næssund, a branch of the Limfjord, is the Næssund Ferry, the smallest and oldest car ferry in the area. New on board, and the first and only woman on this ship, is deckhand Lilian Kohler. She is "girl for everything", but wants more, because Lilian is a trained navigator. She is magically drawn to the bridge, but the old captain doesn't think much of retiring ashore.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: At the girls' campout, Sour launches into a whopper of a yarn about the adventures she and Sweet had in the "Berry Deep Dark Forest." She tries to get Sweet to participate in spinning the tale, but Sour's over-the-top performance leaves Sweet behind. Toward the end, Sour graciously changes the story to pull Sweet into it, giving Sweet the opportunity to toss in an ad lib that makes a nice topper to Sour's story.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Apple's rave review on her berryweb page of Strawberry's new dessert starts a booming mail order dessert business for Berry Bitty City. When Strawberry's stuffed-up nose makes her bake a bad-tasting cake, Apple, afraid the truth will hurt Strawberry's reputation, proclaims it's delicious. The fib snowballs when the Queen of Berryvania reads Apple's review and orders Strawberry's new cake for her ball.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Sour teasing Apple escalates into a "prank war" between the two of them. After the girls' feud disrupts the town, they are sentenced in a Berry Bitty City-style trial to camp alone together for a whole weekend. Miraculously, they emerge best buds, and their friends are relieved, until Sour's influence on Apple turns her into a mini-Sour, and they have to do a personality "makeover" on Apple.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Berrykin Bloom's braggart cousin, Berrykin Bertram, has won the hot sauce competition at the local county fair year after year.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: When the girls discover that Apple's groove booties can teach the pups to dance, Plum gets an idea for a Doggie Dance Show. Wanting to impress them, Huck offers to have TomTom join the show... despite the pup's obvious dislike of performing in public. It's up to Strawberry to help Huck see that he should not force TomTom into something he just doesn't want to do.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: When a simple tune Cherry composes goes viral on the Berryweb, Cherry quickly gets fed up with everyone listening to this song, everywhere, all the time. She goes to comic lengths to get some peace so she can compose the song she's suppose to write for the Queen of Berryvania.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Strawberry and Orange are dangling their legs in the stream when something tickles Orange's foot. She is sent squealing from the water, certain an eel is after her. Strawberry good-naturedly chuckles at her antics. But Orange gets her dander up and wades into the water to face her "attacker." When she looks down into the water, gazing up at her is the cutest, most adorable, puffy-cheeked fish she's ever seen. It's love at first sight. Orange has to take him home.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: At the next Storytime, Strawberry is going to read a new poem. We see her at the podium as she finishes writing it, one afternoon when no one else is in the café except Custard and Pupcake. Strawberry clears her throat and reads the poem aloud. It's a simple, sweet rhyme about the magic of making wishes on falling stars. She tries a few different rhymes as she goes, noting them on her paper. She is startled to hear applause from Mr. Longface Caterpillar who has heard her recital.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Strawberry Shortcake's friends watch her with wide eyes as she everrrrr-so-gently squirts a layer of blueberry smoothie into a tall glass, trying to not disturb the five other multi-colored layers beneath it. It's her tenth attempt to create the world's first Rainbow Smoothie! She has even painted one wall of her café rainbow colors in honor of the soon-to-be new item on the menu. No one dares breathe for fear of spoiling the delicate touch of a master smoothie-squirter at work.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: It's a busy day at Lemon's salon, a charming place that is more than just a hair salon it's one of favorite places for Strawberry and her friends to relax and socialize. All the girls are getting their hair done for the gala grand opening of Mr. Longface's new lawn-bowling and croquet club. They're spirited and laughing and chatting and having a great time, as Lemon runs from one of her friends to the next, doing hair and nails, serving tea and cookies.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Blueberry ordered some Zippy Gro daisy seeds and planted them in her garden. She is surprised that they've sprouted in less than a day despite their descriptive moniker. Strawberry comes by to admire them and Blueberry is reminded that the new cookbook Strawberry ordered has arrived. Strawberry is excited to try out the new corn muffin recipe, as its level of difficulty will be a challenge for her. Strawberry follows the muffin recipe, mixes the ingredients, and double checks it.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake

programme.title: The Good, The Bad And The Tightwad
programme.desc: Clay wakes up in the poor town of Nothing Hill which literally have nothing. Will Clay remember who he is and what he is fighting for. His friends try to help him, but Jorah Tightwad and his Bots get in the way. Clay as the Gray Knight wakes up far away in a place called Nothing Hill. A poor town where they literally have nothing. They harvest dust. Jorah Tightwad though has found that there is gold underneath the town. He convinces the confused Clay to help him put pressure on the poor townsfolk to give up their lots. This is an easy job for the strong Gray Knight. The NEXO KNIGHTS finally track him down and tries to convince him about who he is. But to the Gray Knight they are still his enemies, and a giant battle ensues in order to subdue the Gray Knight. At last, only Macy is left. When she begins to recite the Knights Code, some words and their meaning are able to get through the stone hard shell of the Gray Knight and the Evil that clouded him seems to disappear. Together they are able to return the ownership of the town to the villagers.

programme.title: The Book Of Monsters, Part 1
programme.desc: When Jestro the Jester finds the Book of Monsters, chaos breaks loose in the Kingdom of Knighton. Can the newly graduated Knights from the Knights' Academy save the kingdom? It's final graduation fighting exams for the latest Knights from Knights' Academy. All our new Knights demonstrate their prowess: CLAY, AARON, AXL and LANCE. PRINCESS MACY get to join them, but her father doesn't want her to graduate. As part of the entertainment, MERLOK does an amazing magic trick. His act is followed by…JESTRO, the King's Jester. He's terrible (and he should know to never follow a better act.) Everyone laughed because he's a real joke....a total failure. While Jestro roams the halls fo the King's Castle, forlorn, he hears the BOOK OF MONSTERS calling to him from Merlok's library. The book talks Jestro into gathering as many books of spells as he can carry, but they're interrupted by...Clay! As Jestro quickly pages through the Book of Monsters to attack Clay, Merlok arrives. There's a battle in the library between Jestro and Merlok. Finally, the wizard summons up his most powerful spell in self-defence. BOOM! There's a big, magical explosion and when Clay forces his way back into the library, Merlok, Jestro and the magic books are...GONE!

programme.title: The Book Of Monsters, Part 2
programme.desc: Realizing they must defend the Kingdom from Jestro's monsters, the Knights try to organize but are despondent when they discover their best advisor – Merlok the Magician – has sacrificed himself to save them. When Jestro awakens, he's been blasted miles and miles away from the King's Castle by Merlok's explosive spell. And, it seems, all the books he was trying to steal have been scattered, too. The Book of Monsters broke Jestro' fall and now he can use the book to attack the people who laughed at him. PRINCESS MACY get to join them, but her father doesn't want her to graduate. As part of the entertainment, MERLOK does an amazing magic trick. His act is followed by…JESTRO, the King's Jester. He's terrible (and he should know to never follow a better act.) Everyone laughed because he's a real joke....a total failure. While Jestro roams the halls fo the King's Castle, forlorn, he hears the BOOK OF MONSTERS calling to him from Merlok's library. The book talks Jestro into gathering as many books of spells as he can carry, but they're interrupted by...Clay! As Jestro quickly pages through the Book of Monsters to attack Clay, Merlok arrives. There's a battle in the library between Jestro and Merlok. Finally, the wizard summons up his most powerful spell in self-defence. BOOM! There's a big, magical explosion and when Clay forces his way back into the library, Merlok, Jestro and the magic books are...GONE!

The Book of Monsters broke Jestro' fall and now he can use the book to attack the people who laughed at him. programme.title: The Power Of Merlok

Then Macy remembers her dad has a royal RV…maybe they can “mod” that for their own, “knightly” use? Now the NEXO-Knights get rolling…in THE FORTREX, their own ROLLING CASTLE! This great new HQ, which houses Merlok 2.0 as an operating system, will be how the knights move around Knighton and protect it from Jestro and his monsters. Speaking of the evil jester, in this episode Jestro uses some newly-made monsters to attack a town far from the capitol where he thinks he's safe from the Knights' reach. We see two parallel stories here: the Knights training, learning more about digital magic and getting organized as a team and at the same time we see Jestro making monsters, trying to learn how his powers work and talking to the Book. In the end, the Knights roll up in their castle and defeat Jestro and his marauding monsters. Lance thinks he should be the leader because he's a snot. “Of course I'm the leader…I'm a Richmond.”

programme.title: The Knights Code
programme.desc: Jestro uses the Book of Chaos to unleash, um, chaos and attack the King's hover train to try and kidnap the royal party. The Book of Monsters actually tells Jestro NOT to feed it to him he tells Jestro he's not ready for that kind of power. But Jestro doesn't listen. Now the Book unleashes chaotic monsters and Jestro uses them to attack the King and his party who are on a business-related tour of the kingdom. When the NEXO-Knights show up to stop the monster attacks and realize that they must save King and Queen Halbert – Macy's parents – from the chaotic evil monsters that have been unleashed. Clay asserts himself as leader and brings order to the knights from the chaos. He has his own book: the Book of the Knight's Code. They should all live by it.

programme.title: I Spit On Your Grave: Deja Vu
programme.desc: Finally, after 1978's I Spit On Your Grave shocked the world with its story of a beautiful career woman assaulted and left for dead, and her notorious revenge on those responsible, cinema's most lethal Lady Vengeance returns in the most anticipated sequel of all time. Reuniting star Camille Keaton and original director Meir Zarchi, I Spit On Your Grave: Deja Vu sends now successful writer Jennifer Hills hurtling back to where it all began - to face the wrath of the families of those she murdered. Kidnapped along with her daughter Christy, it's a tense game of hunt - or be hunted - against a ruthless gang of degenerates and their violently unhinged matriarch, Becky. Hailed as a feminist revenge masterpiece by some, and misunderstood as crude exploitation by others, revenge is about to come full circle in Deja Vu, the final chapter in cinema's most shocking cult franchise.

programme.title: G-Loc
programme.desc: In a world on the brink of environmental collapse, mass migration to neighbouring planet, Rhea, is humanity's final hope for survival. The only problem is, in the sixteen Earth years since the first humans landed on Rhea, two hundred and eighty-eight years have passed on the new planet and the existing population are no longer welcoming new arrivals, with the Rheans having set up a space blockade to shot down any ship that tries to cross into their territory. 'Earther', Bran, has big dreams of a better life in this new world, but the odds are stacked against him. Finding himself the lone survivor of a failed emigration attempt, his escape pod floats mindlessly in space and his oxygen is running low. His only chance of survival is to hook up to a rogue Rhean supply ship called The Nysa running on auxiliary power. But after finding the crew on board The Nysa dead, it seems Bran may have more than just a hostile planet to worry about. An intense interstellar thriller with an impressive cast, including Stephen Moyer (True Blood), Casper Van Dien (Starship Troopers) and John Rhys-Davies (the Indiana Jones and Lord of the Rings franchises).

A laugh-out-loud gritty rom-com with a huge ensemble cast including James Lance (Northern Soul, Bronson, Marie Antoinette, Bel Ami), Will Mellor (Two Pints of Lager and a Packet of Crisps, Line of Duty), Larry Lamb (EastEnders, The Hatton Garden Job), Marek Oravec (Captain America: The First Avenger), Wim Snape (The Full Monty, Coronation Street), and Katy Clayton (Casualty, Shameless).

This not only causes a scandal, but sets off a chain of drama events within the family and the royal servants, impacting them to change forever. At the heart of this drama is the relationship between Ranaji, who is still in love with his dead wife, and a commoner, Gayatri who now discovers that becoming a Rani does not necessarily have a fairy tale ending. It is a journey of Gayatri from being a girl with no future since she is a manglik to becoming queen of Ranaji's heart and of the people of the land!

programme.title: Beti Hamari Anmol
programme.desc: In this hugely inspirational success story, Anmol, a small town girl, not only fights the societal obstacles faced by any small town girl in our country but also takes on the social stigma she has had to face for being so short heighted that she has been termed as a “dwarf”. Anmol, with her strong will power and belief in herself, fights the hate she has had to receive from her in-law's. Anmol becomes a doctor with the support of her husband, in the same hospital where her father works as a peon, to win back her dignity as well as bring a lot of pride to her and her in law's family.

programme.title: Yam Kisi Se Kam Nahin

He tries his best to give his family what they need and manages to make a mess of everything in the bargain. Lovable and goofy, this God of Death is anything but grim. Join our hardworking but hen-pecked Yamraj, his beloved buffalo and his motely family and friends in a slice-of-life sitcom to find out how the cookie really crumbles!

programme.title: Stories By Rabindranath Tagore
programme.desc: The Characters Of Tagore'S Stories Spring Into Life Through The Cinematic Imagination Of Acclaimed Filmmaker, Anurag Basu In ‘Stories By Rabindranath Tagore'.Tagore'S Words And Basu'S Vision Have Amalgamated Into A Show That Transports You Back In Time To A World As Complicated As This One But With Far More Appeal And Beauty.

programme.desc: The story highlights the exploitation happening with the ‘Bunkars' in Banaras, whose craft is appreciated all around the world, but they are paid peanuts by the traders. Amidst this, blooms a love story between the two opposites - Gauri, a bunkar and Garv, a trader. The story is of Gauri who belongs to the bunkar community facing series of incidents which destroys her family and swears to bring about a change in their life and stop the exploitation by directly trading the sarees. This becomes a battle with traders creating hurdles in her life but she is unstoppable.

programme.title: Do Chutki Sindoor
programme.desc: Vinayak and Siddhi live in Agra and Siddhi has a sister named Maya, who has a mental capacity of a 9-year-old. Siddhi takes full responsibility of Maya and ensures she is never left alone. Sunaina, their stepmother worries about Maya. Siddhi assures Sunaina that she will not marry until she finds someone who will take care of Maya. On the other hand, Vinayak who is the only son of rich and famous Jayadevi, a shrewd woman who despises the colour black. Vinayak and Siddhi's paths cross when Maya is about to get hit by Vinayak's car. Siddhi intervenes and saves Maya, but in anger slaps Vinayak for calling Maya "Pagal" (crazy). Vinayak realizes that he has fallen for Siddhi and promises to take care of Maya and marries Siddhi to seek revenge and make Maya suffer.

programme.title: LIVE GURBANI KIRTAN FROM AMRITSAR
programme.desc: Live Gurbani Kirtan from Gurudwara Sri Sis Ganj Sahib on GTC Punjabi Television brings viewers a sacred spiritual experience directly from one of the most revered historical Gurudwaras of Sikhism, located in the heart of Delhi. This live telecast offers devotees the divine resonance of Gurbani Kirtan, performed by esteemed Ragis, filling homes with peace, devotion, and spiritual reflection. Gurudwara Sri Sis Ganj Sahib stands as a powerful symbol of supreme sacrifice and unwavering faith, marking the martyrdom of Sri Guru Tegh Bahadur Ji, who laid down his life for the protection of religious freedom and human rights. Through this live broadcast, GTC Punjabi Television connects Sangat across the globe to the serene atmosphere of the Gurudwara, allowing viewers to immerse themselves in Naam Simran, Shabad Kirtan, and the timeless wisdom of Gurbani. The soulful renditions inspire inner calm, strengthen spiritual connection, and spread the universal message of love, equality, and humility as taught by the Sikh Gurus.

programme.title: Gurmat Vichar
programme.desc: Katha by Bhai Sahab Pinder Pal Ji on GTC Punjabi Television presents a profound spiritual discourse rooted in the timeless wisdom of Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji. Renowned for his deep knowledge, powerful narration, and simple yet impactful explanations, Bhai Sahab Pinder Pal Ji brings Gurbani to life by connecting its teachings with everyday human experiences. Through soulful storytelling, historical references, and meaningful interpretations of Gurbani, this Katha guides the Sangat towards self-reflection, humility, and spiritual awakening. Each session offers clarity on life's challenges while emphasizing the values of Naam Simran, Seva, truthful living, and unwavering faith in Waheguru.

Rooted in devotion and reverence, the slot serves as a spiritual pause—where music becomes prayer and faith finds its voice.

programme.desc: Do Hyun hesitates to face the truth that Jun Pyo may have been behind Ri Jin's mother's death. Mr. X advises Do Hyun to confront his past for the sake of his future. Meanwhile, one by one, Do Hyun's personalities appear to say goodbye, and Ri Jin finally faces her childhood self.

programme.title: Partners for Justice Ep.1 (English Dub)
programme.desc: Rookie prosecutor Eun-sol visits her first crime scene. Shocked by the sight of a corpse for the very first time, she is left completely overwhelmed. There, she also comes face to face with the blunt and intimidating forensic pathologist Baek Beom.

programme.title: Partners for Justice Ep.2 (English Dub)
programme.desc: Determined to uncover the truth and clear Hee-kyung's name, Eun-sol refuses to give up on the case. After discovering a crucial piece of evidence, she seeks out Baek Beom in hopes of gaining his help.

programme.title: Partners for Justice Ep.4 (English Dub)
programme.desc: After receiving a call from Choi Hwa-ja, Eun-sol goes to meet her and finds herself in an unexpected situation. Meanwhile, while reviewing Jang Deuk-nam's medical records, Baek Beom discovers a suspicious detail, sending the case in an entirely new direction.

programme.title: Partners for Justice Ep.5 (English Dub)
programme.desc: All the circumstances and evidence surrounding Yeon Mi-rae's murder point to Cha Su-ho as the prime suspect. Even Su-ho himself can no longer trust his own memories.

programme.title: Partners for Justice Ep.6 (English Dub)
programme.desc: Following the suspect's escape route, Eun-sol closes in on the truth. But as she pursues the lead, she suddenly finds herself in unexpected danger.

programme.desc: After the resounding success of the first two seasons, EPIC Channel presents a revamped avatar of its Raja Rasoi series. EPIC Channel's Raja Rasoi series - titled Raja Rasoi Aur Andaaz Anokha - stands true to its name. While the lore and love of Indian food remains just as passionate, the new season presents a discovery oriented show format that transforms table-top cooking into an exciting food lab. Featuring renowned chef Ranveer Brar, the show will take you to his retreat – an old-world bungalow basking in the laidback vibe of Goa and then along on a ride nostalgia and rediscovery both personal and culinary. Ranveer's passion for culinary art makes him a perfect fit as the host for the latest season of the food series. He has dedicated this experimental streak and passion for food to his mentor – Munir Ahmed, a quaint, ordinary yet passionate food enthusiast from the gullies of Lucknow who greatly influenced Brar while growing up in his hometown.

programme.title: Regiment Diaries
programme.desc: The Indian Army is an emotion – a living chronicle of events, that we have the luxury to forget because they remember. The army itself is a family of several regiments, each of which has its own history, identity, and glorious traditions. Regiment Diaries is a tale of the Indian Army unlike any told before. Told by the very men who follow the illustrious feats of their predecessors, it tells timeless tales that warm the heart, moisten the eye, and leave you in awe of the bravest children of India.

programme.title: Sharanam
programme.desc: Sharanam takes viewers on a poignant journey to some of the most revered pilgrimage sites in India to and highlights the traditions, practices, rituals and ideals that bring people to these holy places in search of something greater than themselves. Narrated by Bollywood actress Juhi Chawla, Sharanam showcases testimonies of personal incidents that are the bedrock of the belief, and follows the strong thread of faith that not only binds the pilgrims to their Gods, but also the nation with itself.

programme.title: Destruction Decoded
programme.desc: This series will go back through the record to explore life-altering, earth-shattering, unforgettable events using a combination of carefully selected archive, cutting edge CGI and informative scripting in this popular science format. programme.title: Indipedia
